cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Will you put my name under 'cake design' before you frame our club's prize certificate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Next year's members won't. There's a blank ready for them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually credit the whole baking team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: List us all, with what each did. I'll fetch everyone's names before you seal the frame.

mechanism: A supervises certificate credit by distinguishing shared achievement from named roles so A's design contribution remains recoverable.
confusable: Generic praise seeking differs from D177's lasting formal record; S03 should shape how credit is entered.
comparison: Durable framed team credit differs from village minutes and an unfulfilled thanks action.
seedUse: Keep future members and team objection, making A accommodate others with precise role entries.
